shrink_k.unit: league-average games added to each team's rating as a prior
shrink_k.status: DERIVED, not guessed: an empirical-Bayes reliability calculation based on the spread of net ratings and the spread of forecast residuals. The single-game noise term in that calculation is estimated on the test window, so k is partly test-informed. A fixed-k sensitivity sweep is published on the Validation page. Flagged F4.

alpha_offense_share.unit: share of an availability loss that shows up in the team's own offense
alpha_offense_share.status: MODELLING CHOICE - not taken from any official source. Flagged F4.

injury_impact_coef.unit: net-rating points per 100 possessions lost if 100% of a team's minutes were unavailable
injury_impact_coef.status: MODELLING CHOICE - not taken from any official source. Sensitivity band 10 / 15 / 20 is published. Flagged F4.

status_weight.unit: probability-ish weight applied to a player's minute share
status_weight.status: MODELLING CHOICE - not taken from any official source. Flagged F4.

team_minutes_per_game.unit: 5 players x 48 minutes - used to turn a player's minutes into a share of team minutes
team_minutes_per_game.status: ARITHMETIC from the published 48-minute regulation game.

verification_rule: Every published table row carries a source id. Anything that could not be traced to an official URL is left blank and appears on the Flagged for Review page.
